name: The Dormant Shade
summary: The Dormant Shade is a dark ritual performed at Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. By placing a mystic candle upon an old, blood-soaked table, a traveler summons forth a restless spirit tied to the Forsaken's dark rites of loyalty.

sections.title: A Gruesome Altar
sections.body: On the island of Gunther's Retreat in Brightwater Lake rests a battered, bloody dinner table. Far from an ordinary piece of neglected domestic furniture, it serves as the physical focus for a sinister conjuration. Stained with dried gore and abandoned to the shadows, the table acts as a makeshift ritual slab where death and dark magic linger.

sections.title: The Candle of Beckoning
sections.body: To awaken whatever lurks attached to the site, one must place the Candle of Beckoning upon the bloodied surface and ignite its flame. The candle's light cuts through the Tirisfal gloom, calling forth the spirit of Lillith Nefara from the veil of death. It is an intentional act of necromantic disturbance designed to challenge those who seek to prove their mettle and allegiance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of lighting the candle on the table?
faq.answer: Lighting the Candle of Beckoning on the battered, bloody table summons the shade of Lillith Nefara, a dangerous apparition who must be vanquished.

faq.q: Who is summoned by this ritual?
faq.answer: The ritual draws forth Lillith Nefara, an undead spirit and Scourge agent haunting Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: How does this relate to proving allegiance to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Summoning and destroying Lillith Nefara is an essential test in the quest Proving Allegiance, demonstrating a Forsaken initiate's willingness and ability to root out stubborn apparitions in Tirisfal.

faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?
faq.answer: The ritual occurs at Gunther's Retreat, Gunther Arcanus's island in Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades, at a battered dinner table stained with dried blood just off the island's southern coast.
Anyone possessing the Candle of Beckoning who is undertaking the trials of allegiance for the Forsaken can ignite the flame upon the altar.
The table itself is a grim relic of Lordaeron's fall, steeped in violence and residual dark energies that allow the Candle of Beckoning to anchor and manifest the dormant shade.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, performing rituals over a bloodied altar in the heart of Tirisfal is a grim reminder that their new existence is forged through death, dark magic, and unyielding loyalty to the Dark Lady.
Warlocks understand the resonant power of binding spirits to blood-drenched altars, making this ritual a familiar exercise in manipulating the boundary between life and death.
Shadow priests recognize the call of the candle as an exercise in shadowy communion, pulling a restless lingering soul back into physical conflict.
